$comment: Error codes the core reports. `ErrorCode`: why a request failed, in a failed session result (error.code) and in a bridge error the page gets. `BridgeErrorCode`: why the bridge refused a message from the page. The page shows a message per code (web-ui/src/ui/ErrorNote.tsx); the Kotlin SDK maps ErrorCode onto its public ErrorCode enum, the Swift SDK onto CompanionError.Code.
